feature: Unmatched layer keys are config errors
description: An analyze.layers key under which no graded file falls is reported in config_errors and costs a rule error. A glob key also names the prefix it was probably meant to be. Nothing else about layer classification changes.

specs.description: A glob key that matches no graded file is reported by name
specs.given: A project with graded files src/domain/order.ts and src/ui/view.ts. Its analyze.layers declares "src/domain" as domain and "src/ui/**" as adapters/primary.
specs.when: ArchAnalysisPort::analyze runs on the project root
specs.then: config_errors holds exactly one layer-key entry. That entry contains `analyze.layers["src/ui/**"] matches no file the grade reads`. No entry names "src/domain".

specs.description: Each unmatched key costs what one rule error costs
specs.given: Project A has graded files src/domain/a.rs and src/ports/b.rs, with keys "src/domain" and "src/ports" and no other findings. Project B is identical except that it adds a third key, "src/adpaters" (a typo), which matches no file.
specs.then: Project B's config_errors has one more entry than project A's, and that entry names "src/adpaters". Project B's health_score is exactly 10 lower than project A's.

specs.description: A key whose only files are removed by analyze.exclude is reported
specs.given: Graded files are src/domain/a.ts plus src/generated/client.ts. analyze.exclude removes src/generated. analyze.layers declares "src/domain" and "src/generated".
specs.then: config_errors holds an entry naming analyze.layers["src/generated"] as matching no file the grade reads. No entry names "src/domain".

specs.description: Two unmatched keys produce two entries
specs.given: Graded file src/domain/a.ts. Keys are "src/domain", "src/old_folder" and "lib/ui", and nothing exists under the last two.
specs.then: config_errors holds two layer-key entries, one naming "src/old_folder" and one naming "lib/ui". The health_score is 20 lower than the same project without those two keys.

specs.description: A string prefix that does not fall on a segment boundary is not a match
specs.given: The only graded file is src/domainx/a.ts. analyze.layers declares the key "src/domain".
specs.then: config_errors holds an entry naming analyze.layers["src/domain"]. The key is not counted as matching src/domainx/a.ts.

specs.description: A source-file key that names an existing module is not an error
specs.given: The graded files are src/store/disk.rs and src/domain/a.rs, and src/store.rs does not exist. Keys are "src/store.rs" and "src/domain".
specs.then: config_errors holds no entry naming "src/store.rs" or "src/domain", because src/store/disk.rs falls under the module that "src/store.rs" names.

specs.description: A key that names a graded file exactly, or a folder holding one, is not an error
specs.given: Graded files are src/main.rs and src/domain/deep/x.rs. Keys are "src/main.rs" and "src/domain".
specs.then: config_errors holds no layer-key entries, and the health_score equals the score computed from the other findings alone.

specs.description: Layer-key errors correspond one to one with unmatched keys
specs.given: Any project with any set of analyze.layers keys and any analyze.exclude
specs.then: The number of config_errors entries of the form `analyze.layers["K"] matches no file the grade reads` equals the number of keys K under which no graded file falls. Each such K is named in exactly one entry. Every such entry adds 10 points of penalty, saturating at a score of 0.

specs.description: A ** key is told that keys are prefixes and is offered the prefix
specs.given: The graded file is src/ui/view.ts. The key is "src/ui/**".
specs.then: The config_errors entry for "src/ui/**" says that analyze.layers keys are path prefixes, not globs. It names the prefix "src/ui", with the trailing slash removed.

specs.description: The ? and [ characters count as glob characters, and the prefix stops before the first of them
specs.given: There are no graded files under the keys "src/a?c/x" and "lib/[ab]/y".
specs.then: The entry for "src/a?c/x" names the prefix "src/a". The entry for "lib/[ab]/y" names the prefix "lib". Both say that keys are path prefixes, not globs.

specs.description: An unmatched key with no glob character gets no glob hint
specs.given: The key "src/adpaters" matches no graded file.
specs.then: The config_errors entry for "src/adpaters" names the key. It does not mention globs and does not propose a prefix.

specs.description: A glob key is not read as a glob even when files would match the pattern
specs.given: The graded files are src/ui/view.ts and src/ui/deep/panel.ts. The key "src/ui/**" is declared as adapters/primary. No other key covers src/ui.
specs.then: Neither file is classified as adapters/primary, and both appear in coverage.unclassified. config_errors holds the glob-hint entry for "src/ui/**".

specs.description: The proposed prefix is the key cut at its first glob character
specs.given: Any unmatched key K that contains at least one of the characters *, ? or [
specs.then: K's entry states that keys are path prefixes, not globs. It names P, where P is K up to its first *, ? or [ with any trailing '/' removed. Any unmatched key without those characters gets an entry with no such statement.

specs.description: A project without analyze.layers grades as before
specs.given: A project with no analyze.layers in .hexa/project.json
specs.then: config_errors holds no layer-key entries. Classification, violations, coverage and health_score are as they were before this ADR.

specs.description: The S26 fixture: the keys are still read as prefixes, and the gap is now reported
specs.given: Graded files are src/domain/order.ts and src/ui/view.ts, where view.ts imports order.ts. The keys are "src/domain/**" (domain) and "src/ui/**" (adapters/primary).
specs.then: Both files remain unclassified in coverage, as before. config_errors holds two entries, one for each key, and each carries the glob hint ("src/domain" and "src/ui"). The health_score is 20 lower than with no analyze.layers.

specs.description: An unmatched key does not change how other files are classified
specs.given: A project whose matching keys classify src/domain/a.rs as domain and src/adapters/primary/cli.rs as adapters/primary, with one boundary violation between them. A second copy of the project adds the unmatched key "src/nothing".
specs.then: The violations, coverage, dead_exports, circular_deps and the layer of every file are identical in both copies. They differ only in the one config_errors entry for "src/nothing" and a score 10 points lower.

specs.description: A project whose keys all match gains no layer-key config errors
specs.given: A project where every analyze.layers key has at least one graded file under it
specs.then: config_errors contains no entry of the form `analyze.layers[...] matches no file the grade reads`, and the health_score is unaffected by its layer keys.

specs.description: Unmatched keys change only config_errors and the score
specs.given: Any project P, and P', which is P with any set of keys added that match no graded file
specs.then: P' has the same violations, coverage, dead_exports, circular_deps, orphan_files, unused_ports, file_count and edge_count as P. Its config_errors equals P's plus one entry for each added key. Its health_score is P's score minus 10 for each added key, saturating at 0.
